terra.problem: The sources call Hobah a place, but do not establish that it was a region. Use “place” rather than “region.”

The moment says Abram divided his forces, routed the army, and brought back Lot and the goods, but the passage does not say those actions happened at Hobah. It says only that the pursuit reached Hobah.
“Routed” and “pursued” may be difficult at a fifth-grade reading level. Consider “defeated” and “chased.”
